page.title: Lists
page.lede: Name a set once and use it in any rule. Rules name a list by its id, so renaming a list never breaks a rule.

access.deniedHint: Ask an administrator for the insurance rules permission.

items.failed: The item lists could not be loaded.
items.lede: An item list built from fields updates itself: a new item with a matching code joins it the day it is created, with no rule edit. Item lists are part of the guard draft and go through approval with it.
items.empty: The draft has no item list yet.

editor.idHint: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. It never changes.
editor.filtersHint: An item matches a filter when every field row holds. The list holds the items of any filter.
editor.saved: The item list is saved in the draft
editor.saveFailed: The item list could not be saved
editor.stale: Someone saved the guard draft after you opened it. Reload it and make your change again.
